incremental FeedExecStrategy + FeedExecAccount on the STREAMING side (never run_backtest)

watermarks (decision watermark, frequency counters, cooldown, pending order, partial/open position, operating + independent control account, kill state, deterministic output IDs)

any prerecorded signal/control/prediction table fed to inference
